_note: Peces de l'animació de gastronomia, generades amb IA (FLUX.1-schnell via Hugging Face, skill generar-imatges). No són fotos del càmping. Cada peça es genera sola sobre fons blanc i després se'n treu el fons (scripts/build-food-pieces.ts).
style: Isolated on a plain pure white seamless background, soft even studio daylight, only a very faint soft shadow, single object perfectly centered and fully inside the frame with generous white margin around it. Photorealistic, sharp, appetizing commercial food photography.

pieces.pan: Top-down photograph, seen exactly from above, of one empty black steel paella pan with two side handles, clean and empty.
pieces.rice: Top-down macro photograph of cooked saffron yellow paella rice with a few green peas and small pieces of red pepper, filling the entire frame edge to edge as a flat texture, evenly lit. No pan, no plate, no background visible.
pieces.prawn: Top-down photograph of one single cooked whole red prawn with shell, curved, glossy.
pieces.mussel: Top-down photograph of one single cooked open mussel in its dark blue-black shell with the orange meat visible.
pieces.lemon: Top-down photograph of one single fresh lemon wedge, bright yellow.
pieces.parsley: Top-down photograph of one small sprig of fresh green parsley leaves.
pieces.cone: Side view photograph of one single empty crispy waffle ice cream cone standing upright, golden brown, pointing down, nothing inside.
pieces.scoop-pistachio: Side view photograph of one single round scoop of pistachio ice cream, pastel green, with a slightly rough scooped texture.
pieces.scoop-strawberry: Side view photograph of one single round scoop of strawberry ice cream, pink, with a slightly rough scooped texture.
pieces.scoop-chocolate: Side view photograph of one single round scoop of dark chocolate ice cream, rich brown, with a slightly rough scooped texture.
pieces.cocktail: Side view photograph of one tall highball glass filled with an orange spritz cocktail and ice cubes, vivid orange drink, glass standing upright, no garnish, no straw.
pieces.orange: Front view photograph of one single round slice of fresh orange, cut crosswise, bright and juicy.
pieces.mint: Top-down photograph of one small sprig of fresh green mint leaves.
pieces.straw: Side view photograph of one single red and white striped paper drinking straw, straight, standing vertically.
